UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated DhanRatan user profile linked to a Google Sign-In Firebase Auth session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner (must match request.auth.uid).

fullName.description: Display name of the player (1-100 characters).

username.description: Username or Google email identifier (1-120 characters).

phone.description: 10-digit mobile number associated with the player profile.

balance.description: Current wallet balance in INR points (0 to 100000000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user private profile documents owned by the authenticated Firebase user.
